vi.L: "Và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, này, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã lấy người Lê-vi từ giữa con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên thay cho mọi con đầu lòng, [là con] mở lòng mẹ trong con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên; và người Lê-vi sẽ thuộc về {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.
vi.B: "Này, chính {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã chọn người Lê-vi từ giữa dân Y-sơ-ra-ên thay cho mọi con đầu lòng, tức là đứa con đầu tiên mỗi người mẹ trong Y-sơ-ra-ên sinh ra. Người Lê-vi thuộc về {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.
vi.R: "Ta đã chọn người Lê-vi từ giữa dân Y-sơ-ra-ên. Họ sẽ thay thế cho mọi con trai cả trong Y-sơ-ra-ên, là đứa con đầu tiên mỗi người mẹ sinh ra. Người Lê-vi thuộc về {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.

ko.L: "그리고 나, 보라, 내가 이스라엘 자손 가운데서 레위인을 취하였으니, 이스라엘 자손 가운데서 태를 연 모든 맏아들 대신이다. 레위인은 내 것이 될 것이다.
ko.B: "보아라, 내가 이스라엘 백성 가운데서 레위인을 데려왔다. 이스라엘에서 어머니가 처음 낳은 맏아들을 모두 대신하게 한 것이다. 레위인은 내 것이다.
ko.R: "내가 이스라엘 사람들 가운데서 레위인을 골랐다. 레위인은 이스라엘의 모든 맏아들, 곧 어머니마다 처음 낳은 아이를 대신할 것이다. 레위인은 내 것이다.

pt.L: "E eu, eis que tomei os levitas dentre os filhos de Israel em lugar de todo primogênito que abre o ventre entre os filhos de Israel; e os levitas serão {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}}.
pt.B: "Eu mesmo tomei os levitas dentre os israelitas em lugar de todo primogênito, o primeiro filho que cada mãe tem em Israel. Os levitas pertencem a {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}.
pt.R: "Eu escolhi os levitas dentre os israelitas. Eles vão ocupar o lugar de cada filho mais velho em Israel, o primeiro menino que cada mãe tem. Os levitas pertencem a {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}.

am.L: «እኔም፣ እነሆ፣ ከእስራኤል ልጆች ማኅፀን በሚከፍት በኩር ሁሉ ፈንታ ሌዋውያንን ከእስራኤል ልጆች መካከል ወስጃለሁ፤ ሌዋውያንም የእኔ ይሆናሉ።
am.B: «እኔ ራሴ በእስራኤል የእያንዳንዲቱ እናት የመጀመሪያ ልጅ በሆነው በኩር ሁሉ ፈንታ ሌዋውያንን ከእስራኤል ልጆች መካከል ወስጃለሁ። ሌዋውያን የእኔ ናቸው።
am.R: «ሌዋውያንን ከእስራኤላውያን መካከል መርጫለሁ። እነርሱ በእስራኤል ባለው የመጀመሪያ ወንድ ልጅ ሁሉ ፈንታ ይሆናሉ፤ ይህም እያንዳንዲቱ እናት የወለደችው የመጀመሪያ ሕፃን ነው። ሌዋውያን የእኔ ናቸው።

hi.L: "और मैं, देखो, मैंने {{gender:इस्राएल की सन्तान|इस्राएल के पुत्रों}} में से लेवियों को {{gender:इस्राएल की सन्तान|इस्राएल के पुत्रों}} में से हर पहलौठे के बदले, जो गर्भ को खोलता है, ले लिया है; और लेवी मेरे होंगे।
hi.B: "देखो, मैंने स्वयं इस्राएलियों में से लेवियों को हर पहलौठे के बदले, अर्थात् इस्राएल में हर माँ की पहली सन्तान के बदले, ले लिया है। लेवी मेरे हैं।
hi.R: "मैंने इस्राएलियों में से लेवियों को चुन लिया है। वे इस्राएल के हर पहलौठे बेटे की जगह लेंगे, यानी हर माँ के पहले बच्चे की। लेवी मेरे हैं।

ru.L: «И {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}}, вот, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} взял левитов из среды {{gender:детей Израиля|сынов Израиля}} вместо всякого первенца, открывающего утробу, из {{gender:детей Израиля|сынов Израиля}}; и будут {{deity_pronoun:моими|Моими}} левиты.
ru.B: «Вот, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} Сам взял левитов из среды израильтян вместо всякого первенца, первого ребёнка, рождённого матерью в Израиле. Левиты принадлежат {{deity_pronoun:мне|Мне}}.
ru.R: «Я выбрал левитов из всех израильтян. Они займут место каждого старшего сына в Израиле, первого ребёнка у каждой матери. Левиты принадлежат {{deity_pronoun:мне|Мне}}.

ja.L: 「そしてわたしは、見なさい、イスラエルの子らの中からレビ人を取った。イスラエルの子らのうちの、胎を開くすべての初子の代わりである。レビ人はわたしのものとなる。
ja.B: 「見なさい。わたしは、イスラエルの人々のすべての初子、すなわち母親が最初に産んだ子の代わりに、イスラエルの人々の中からレビ人を取った。レビ人はわたしのものである。
ja.R: 「わたしは、イスラエルの人々の中からレビ人を選んだ。レビ人は、イスラエルのすべての長男の代わりとなる。母親が最初に産む子どもの代わりである。レビ人はわたしのものである。

uk.L: «А Я, ось Я взяв левитів з-поміж {{gender:нащадків Ізраїля|синів Ізраїля}} замість кожного первістка, що відкриває утробу, з-поміж {{gender:нащадків Ізраїля|синів Ізраїля}}, і левити будуть {{deity_pronoun:мої|Мої}}.
uk.B: «Ось Я сам узяв левитів з-поміж ізраїльтян замість кожного первістка, першої дитини, народженої кожною матірʼю в Ізраїлі. Левити належать {{deity_pronoun:мені|Мені}}.
uk.R: «Я вибрав левитів з-поміж ізраїльтян. Вони стануть замість кожного найстаршого сина в Ізраїлі, першої дитини кожної матері. Левити належать {{deity_pronoun:мені|Мені}}.

id.L: "Dan {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}}, lihatlah, {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} telah mengambil orang Lewi dari antara bani Israel sebagai ganti setiap anak sulung yang membuka kandungan di antara bani Israel, dan orang Lewi itu akan menjadi milik-{{deity_pronoun:ku|Ku}}.
id.B: "Ketahuilah, {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}}lah yang telah mengambil orang Lewi dari antara orang Israel sebagai ganti setiap anak sulung, yang pertama lahir dari kandungan, di antara orang Israel. Orang Lewi itu milik-{{deity_pronoun:ku|Ku}}.
id.R: "Aku sudah memilih orang Lewi dari antara orang Israel. Mereka akan menggantikan setiap anak laki-laki tertua di Israel, yaitu anak pertama yang dilahirkan setiap ibu. Orang Lewi adalah milik-{{deity_pronoun:ku|Ku}}.

zh.L: “看哪，我从{{gender:以色列的子孙|以色列的儿子}}中拣选了利未人，代替{{gender:以色列的子孙|以色列的儿子}}中一切头生的，就是一切头一个打开母腹的；利未人要归我。
zh.B: “看，是我亲自从以色列人中拣选了利未人，代替所有头生的，就是以色列每位母亲所生的第一个孩子。利未人是属于我的。
zh.R: “我从以色列人中选了利未人。他们要代替以色列每一家的长子，就是每位母亲生的第一个孩子。利未人是属于我的。

tl.L: "At ako, narito, kinuha ko ang mga Levita mula sa mga anak ni Israel kapalit ng bawat panganay na nagbubukas ng sinapupunan sa mga anak ni Israel, at ang mga Levita ay magiging akin.
tl.B: "Tingnan mo, ako mismo ang kumuha sa mga Levita mula sa mga Israelita kapalit ng bawat panganay, ang unang anak na isinilang ng bawat ina sa Israel. Ang mga Levita ay akin.
tl.R: "Pinili ko ang mga Levita mula sa mga Israelita. Sila ang papalit sa bawat panganay na lalaki sa Israel, ang unang sanggol ng bawat ina. Ang mga Levita ay akin.

decisions.choice: opening of the womb: the first child a mother bears
decisions.reason: The phrase defines "firstborn" by the mother: her first child (Exodus 13:2, 12). The firstborn sons of Israel were claimed by God (verse 13).

decisions.choice: in place of: the Levites stand in for Israel's firstborn
decisions.reason: Instead of each family giving its firstborn son to serve the LORD, the tribe of Levi is given to him in their place (verses 40-51; 8:16-18).

decisions.choice: And I, look: an emphatic opening
decisions.reason: The pronoun "I" stands first, before the word that calls for attention. It stresses that this is God's own act.

decisions.choice: every oldest son
decisions.reason: Readable says "oldest son" because verses 40-43 show that the firstborn males are meant, and "firstborn" is a hard word for young readers.

decisions.choice: "[con] mở lòng mẹ" for "the opening of the womb" at Literal
decisions.reason: Vietnamese "lòng mẹ" is the ordinary word for the womb in this sense; "tử cung" would be clinical. Balanced and Readable say "the first child each mother bears".

decisions.choice: "그리고 나, 보라, 내가" keeps the emphatic opening at Literal
decisions.reason: The Hebrew puts "I" first and then "look"; the Literal keeps both. The English "Myself" span has no Korean counterpart, since Korean has no capitals (see 1:53).

decisions.choice: Eu mesmo (B)
decisions.reason: Balanced gives the emphasis of "And I, look" (m3) with "Eu mesmo"; Literal keeps "eis que". "Eu" for God takes no setting span in Portuguese, so the English span on "myself" has none here.

decisions.choice: cada filho mais velho; o primeiro menino que cada mãe tem (R)
decisions.reason: As the English Readable says "oldest son" (r-en-1), Readable says "filho mais velho" here and in verses 40-50, and "o primeiro menino que cada mãe tem", the wording of Exodus 13:2 in Portuguese.

decisions.choice: "የመጀመሪያ ወንድ ልጅ" (R) for the firstborn in 3:12-50; "በኩር" at Literal and Balanced.
decisions.reason: As the terms list has it ("በኩር" L, B; "የመጀመሪያ ልጅ" R). Only sons are counted here, so Readable says "son", as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun spans ("मैं", "मेरे")
decisions.reason: Devanagari has no capital letters, so the English deity_pronoun setting has nothing to change in Hindi, and the Hindi text has no deity_pronoun spans. Respect for God comes from the honorific third person ("उन्होंने") in the narrative. The same through the chapter.

decisions.choice: "पहलौठा बेटा" (R)
decisions.reason: "पहलौठा" (firstborn) is the term at every level. Readable adds "बेटा", since verses 40-43 show that the firstborn males are meant, as the English Readable says "oldest son". The same through the chapter.

decisions.choice: "{{deity_pronoun:я|Я}}" in mid-sentence; "Сам" with no span
alternatives: a plain capital "Я" with no setting
decisions.reason: For the whole of Numbers, as in Exodus: God's "я" in mid-sentence takes the deity_pronoun span with "мой", "меня", "мне", since English "I" is always a capital and needs none. The emphatic "Сам" (the English "myself") takes no span, like "свой" and "себя".

decisions.choice: "старший сын" (R); "первенец" (L, B)
decisions.reason: As the English Readable says "oldest son": verses 40-43 show that firstborn males are meant, and "первенец" is a harder word for young readers. Readable keeps this through the chapter; firstborn animals stay "первенцы".

decisions.choice: bekhor "初子" (L, B), "長男" (R); opening of the womb "胎を開く" (L), "母親が最初に産んだ子" (B, R)
decisions.reason: 初子 is the form Exodus 13:2 uses for the firstborn claimed by God; Readable says oldest son, as the English R does.

decisions.choice: "わたしのもの" with no deity_pronoun span
decisions.reason: Japanese renderings carry no deity_pronoun spans (style guide 7); hinneh in God's speech is "見なさい" (L, B) as GEN-consistency.

decisions.choice: "Я" at the start of God's sentence is written with its capital and no span; "{{deity_pronoun:мої|Мої}}", "{{deity_pronoun:мені|Мені}}" mid-sentence
decisions.reason: As in the New Testament books, a pronoun for God that opens a sentence takes its capital plainly, and the deity pronoun setting covers the others. Where the English has "myself", Balanced has "сам", which takes no span.

decisions.choice: God's "I" is "Aku": plain at the start of a sentence, in a deity_pronoun span inside one, as are "-{{deity_pronoun:ku|Ku}}" and "diri-{{deity_pronoun:ku|Ku}}"
decisions.reason: As the style guide's section 4: Indonesian "aku" is not capitalised for people, so God's first person takes a span, except where a capital opens the sentence anyway. "And I, look" (m3) is "Dan Aku, lihatlah" at Literal and "Ketahuilah, Akulah" at Balanced.

decisions.choice: 我 (no deity_pronoun span)
decisions.reason: The English has deity_pronoun spans on "mine", "me" and "myself" where God speaks. God speaking of himself says "我", which takes no span in Chinese (style guide section 4). The same through this chapter.

decisions.choice: 头生的 (L, B); 长子 (R)
decisions.reason: "Firstborn" as Exodus 13: Literal and Balanced "头生的", and "头一个打开母腹的" for "the one that opens the womb" (Exodus 13:12); Readable "长子", the oldest son, as the English Readable (verses 40-43 count males).

decisions.choice: "nagbubukas ng sinapupunan" (L); "ang unang anak na isinilang ng bawat ina" (B); "ang unang sanggol ng bawat ina" (R)
decisions.reason: The first child a mother bears (m1); "panganay na lalaki" in Readable, as English (en1).

decisions.choice: "kapalit ng" (L, B); "papalit sa" (R)
decisions.reason: The Levites stand in for Israel's firstborn (m2).

decisions.choice: "At ako, narito" (L); "ako mismo" (B)
decisions.reason: An emphatic opening (m3).

source.text: כִּ֣י לִי֮ כָּל־בְּכוֹר֒ בְּיוֹם֩ הַכֹּתִ֨י כָל־בְּכ֜וֹר בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֗יִם הִקְדַּ֨שְׁתִּי לִ֤י כָל־בְּכוֹר֙ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מֵאָדָ֖ם עַד־בְּהֵמָ֑ה לִ֥י יִהְי֖וּ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: For to me [is] every firstborn; on [the] day I struck every firstborn in [the] land of Egypt I set apart for myself every firstborn in Israel, from man to beast. To me they will be. I [am] Yahweh.

en.L: For every firstborn [is] {{deity_pronoun:mine|Mine}}. On the day I struck down every firstborn in the land of Egypt, I set apart for {{deity_pronoun:myself|Myself}} every firstborn in Israel, from {{gender:human|man}} to beast. They shall be {{deity_pronoun:mine|Mine}}. I [am] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}."
en.B: For every firstborn is {{deity_pronoun:mine|Mine}}. When I struck down every firstborn in the land of Egypt, I made holy to {{deity_pronoun:myself|Myself}} every firstborn in Israel, both human and animal. They are to be {{deity_pronoun:mine|Mine}}. I am {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}."
en.R: Every firstborn belongs to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. When I killed all the firstborn in Egypt, I set apart for {{deity_pronoun:myself|Myself}} every firstborn in Israel, both people and animals. They belong to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. I am {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}."

es.L: Porque todo primogénito [es] {{deity_pronoun:mío|Mío}}. El día en que herí a todo primogénito en la tierra de Egipto, aparté para {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} a todo primogénito en Israel, desde {{gender:el ser humano|el hombre}} hasta el animal. Serán {{deity_pronoun:míos|Míos}}. Yo [soy] {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}».
es.B: Porque todo primogénito es {{deity_pronoun:mío|Mío}}. Cuando herí de muerte a todos los primogénitos en la tierra de Egipto, consagré para {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} a todo primogénito en Israel, tanto de personas como de animales. Han de ser {{deity_pronoun:míos|Míos}}. Yo soy {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}».
es.R: Todo primogénito {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} pertenece. Cuando maté a todos los primogénitos en Egipto, aparté para {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} a todo primogénito en Israel, tanto personas como animales. Ellos {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} pertenecen. Yo soy {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}».

fr.L: Car tout premier-né [est] à {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}. Le jour où j’ai frappé tout premier-né dans le pays d’Égypte, j’ai mis à part pour {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} tout premier-né en Israël, depuis {{gender:l’être humain|l’homme}} jusqu’à la bête. Ils seront à {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}. Je [suis] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. »
fr.B: Car tout premier-né est à {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}. Quand j’ai frappé tous les premiers-nés du pays d’Égypte, je {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} suis consacré tout premier-né en Israël, les humains comme les animaux. Ils doivent être à {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}. Je suis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. »
fr.R: Tout premier-né {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}appartient. Quand j’ai fait mourir tous les premiers-nés en Égypte, j’ai mis à part pour {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} tous les premiers-nés en Israël, les gens comme les animaux. Ils {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}appartiennent. Je suis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. »

sw.L: Kwa maana kila mzaliwa wa kwanza [ni] {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}. Siku ile nilipompiga kila mzaliwa wa kwanza katika nchi ya Misri, nilijitengea kila mzaliwa wa kwanza katika Israeli, tangu mwanadamu hata mnyama. Watakuwa {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}. Mimi [ni] {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}."
sw.B: Kwa maana kila mzaliwa wa kwanza ni {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}. Nilipowapiga wazaliwa wote wa kwanza katika nchi ya Misri, nilijitakasia kila mzaliwa wa kwanza katika Israeli, wanadamu na wanyama pia. Watakuwa {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}. Mimi ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}."
sw.R: Kila mzaliwa wa kwanza ni {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}. Nilipowaua wazaliwa wote wa kwanza katika Misri, nilijitengea kila mzaliwa wa kwanza katika Israeli, watu na wanyama. Wao ni {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}. Mimi ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}."

vi.L: Vì mọi con đầu lòng [đều] thuộc về {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. Vào ngày {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đánh hạ mọi con đầu lòng trong xứ Ai Cập, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã biệt riêng cho mình mọi con đầu lòng trong Y-sơ-ra-ên, từ người đến thú vật. Chúng sẽ thuộc về {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. Ta [là] {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}."
vi.B: Vì mọi con đầu lòng đều thuộc về {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. Khi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đánh hạ mọi con đầu lòng trong xứ Ai Cập, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã biệt riêng ra thánh cho mình mọi con đầu lòng trong Y-sơ-ra-ên, cả người lẫn thú vật. Chúng phải thuộc về {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. Ta là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}."
vi.R: Mọi con đầu lòng đều thuộc về {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. Khi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} giết mọi con đầu lòng ở Ai Cập, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã giữ riêng cho mình mọi con đầu lòng trong Y-sơ-ra-ên, cả người lẫn súc vật. Chúng thuộc về {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. Ta là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}."

ko.L: 모든 처음 난 것은 내 것이기 때문이다. 내가 이집트 땅에서 처음 난 것을 모두 친 날에, 사람부터 짐승까지 이스라엘에서 처음 난 것을 모두 나를 위하여 거룩하게 하였다. 그들은 내 것이 될 것이다. 나는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}이다."
ko.B: 처음 난 것은 모두 내 것이다. 내가 이집트 땅에서 처음 난 것을 모두 쳐 죽인 날에, 이스라엘에서 처음 난 것은 사람이든 짐승이든 모두 나에게 거룩하게 구별해 두었다. 그들은 내 것이다. 나는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}이다."
ko.R: 처음 난 것은 모두 내 것이다. 내가 이집트에서 처음 난 것을 모두 죽였을 때, 이스라엘에서 처음 난 것은 사람이든 짐승이든 모두 내 것으로 구별해 두었다. 그들은 내 것이다. 나는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}이다."

pt.L: Porque todo primogênito [é] {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}}. No dia em que feri todo primogênito na terra do Egito, separei para {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}} todo primogênito em Israel, desde {{gender:o ser humano|o homem}} até o animal. Serão {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}}. Eu [sou] {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}."
pt.B: Porque todo primogênito é {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}}. Quando feri todo primogênito na terra do Egito, consagrei a {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}} todo primogênito em Israel, tanto de gente como de animal. Eles serão {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}}. Eu sou {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}."
pt.R: Todo primogênito pertence a {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}. Quando matei todos os primogênitos no Egito, separei para {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}} todo primogênito em Israel, tanto pessoas como animais. Eles pertencem a {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}. Eu sou {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}."

am.L: በኩር ሁሉ የእኔ ነውና፤ በግብፅ ምድር በኩርን ሁሉ በመታሁበት ቀን ከሰው እስከ እንስሳ ድረስ በእስራኤል ያለውን በኩር ሁሉ ለራሴ ለየሁ፤ የእኔ ይሆናሉ፤ እኔ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} [ነኝ]።»
am.B: በኩር ሁሉ የእኔ ነውና። በግብፅ ምድር በኩርን ሁሉ በመታሁ ጊዜ፣ በእስራኤል ያለውን በኩር ሁሉ፣ ሰውንም እንስሳንም፣ ለራሴ ቀደስኩ። የእኔ ይሆናሉ። እኔ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ነኝ።»
am.R: የመጀመሪያ ልጅ ሁሉ የእኔ ነው። በግብፅ የመጀመሪያ ልጆችን ሁሉ በገደልኩ ጊዜ፣ በእስራኤል ያሉትን የመጀመሪያ ልጆች ሁሉ፣ የሰውንም የእንስሳንም፣ ለራሴ ለየሁ። እነርሱ የእኔ ናቸው። እኔ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ነኝ።»

hi.L: क्योंकि हर पहलौठा मेरा [है]। जिस दिन मैंने मिस्र देश में हर पहलौठे को मारा, उस दिन मैंने इस्राएल में हर पहलौठे को, मनुष्य से लेकर पशु तक, अपने लिए पवित्र ठहराया। वे मेरे होंगे। मैं {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} [हूँ]।"
hi.B: क्योंकि हर पहलौठा मेरा है। जब मैंने मिस्र देश में हर पहलौठे को मार डाला, तब मैंने इस्राएल में हर पहलौठे को, क्या मनुष्य क्या पशु, अपने लिए पवित्र किया। वे मेरे ही रहें। मैं {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} हूँ।"
hi.R: हर पहलौठा मेरा है। जब मैंने मिस्र में सब पहलौठों को मार डाला, तब मैंने इस्राएल में हर पहलौठे को अपने लिए अलग कर लिया, चाहे वह मनुष्य हो या पशु। वे मेरे हैं। मैं {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} हूँ।"

ru.L: Потому что {{deity_pronoun:мой|Мой}} всякий первенец. В день, [когда] {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} поразил всякого первенца в земле Египта, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} посвятил себе всякого первенца в Израиле, от человека до скота. Они будут {{deity_pronoun:моими|Моими}}. Я — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}.»
ru.B: Ведь всякий первенец — {{deity_pronoun:мой|Мой}}. Когда {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} поразил всех первенцев в земле Египта, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} освятил для себя всякого первенца в Израиле, и человека, и животное. Они должны быть {{deity_pronoun:моими|Моими}}. Я — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}.»
ru.R: Каждый первенец принадлежит {{deity_pronoun:мне|Мне}}. Когда {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} убил всех первенцев в Египте, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} выбрал для себя каждого первенца в Израиле, и людей, и животных. Они принадлежат {{deity_pronoun:мне|Мне}}. Я — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}.»

ja.L: すべての初子はわたしのものだからである。わたしがエジプトの地ですべての初子を打った日に、わたしはイスラエルのすべての初子を、人から家畜に至るまで、わたしのために聖別した。彼らはわたしのものとなる。わたしは{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}である。」
ja.B: すべての初子はわたしのものである。わたしがエジプトの地ですべての初子を打ったとき、イスラエルのすべての初子を、人も家畜も、わたしのものとして聖別した。彼らはわたしのものである。わたしは{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}である。」
ja.R: 最初に生まれた子は、みなわたしのものである。わたしはエジプトで最初に生まれた子をみな殺したとき、イスラエルで最初に生まれた子を、人も動物も、すべてわたしのものとして取り分けた。彼らはわたしのものである。わたしは{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}である。」

uk.L: Бо кожен первісток — {{deity_pronoun:мій|Мій}}. У день, [коли] Я вразив кожного первістка в землі Єгипту, Я посвятив {{deity_pronoun:собі|Собі}} кожного первістка в Ізраїлі, від людини до худоби. Вони будуть {{deity_pronoun:мої|Мої}}. Я — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}.»
uk.B: Бо кожен первісток — {{deity_pronoun:мій|Мій}}. Коли Я вразив кожного первістка в землі Єгипту, Я освятив для {{deity_pronoun:себе|Себе}} кожного первістка в Ізраїлі, і людей, і тварин. Вони мають бути {{deity_pronoun:моїми|Моїми}}. Я — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}.»
uk.R: Кожен первісток належить {{deity_pronoun:мені|Мені}}. Коли Я вбив усіх первістків у Єгипті, Я відділив для {{deity_pronoun:себе|Себе}} кожного первістка в Ізраїлі, і людей, і тварин. Вони належать {{deity_pronoun:мені|Мені}}. Я — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}.»

id.L: Sebab setiap anak sulung [adalah] milik-{{deity_pronoun:ku|Ku}}. Pada hari {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} membunuh setiap anak sulung di tanah Mesir, {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} menguduskan bagi diri-{{deity_pronoun:ku|Ku}} setiap anak sulung di Israel, dari manusia sampai binatang. Mereka akan menjadi milik-{{deity_pronoun:ku|Ku}}. Akulah {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}."
id.B: Sebab setiap anak sulung adalah milik-{{deity_pronoun:ku|Ku}}. Pada waktu {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} membunuh semua anak sulung di tanah Mesir, {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} menguduskan bagi diri-{{deity_pronoun:ku|Ku}} semua anak sulung di Israel, baik manusia maupun hewan. Mereka milik-{{deity_pronoun:ku|Ku}}. Akulah {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}."
id.R: Setiap anak sulung adalah milik-{{deity_pronoun:ku|Ku}}. Ketika {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} membunuh semua anak sulung di Mesir, {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} mengkhususkan bagi diri-{{deity_pronoun:ku|Ku}} setiap anak sulung di Israel, baik manusia maupun hewan. Mereka milik-{{deity_pronoun:ku|Ku}}. Aku ini {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}."

zh.L: 因为一切头生的都是我的。我在埃及地击杀一切头生的那日，就把以色列中一切头生的，从人到牲畜，都分别出来归我；他们要归我。我是{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}。”
zh.B: 因为所有头生的都是我的。我击杀埃及地所有头生的时候，就使以色列中所有头生的，无论是人还是牲畜，都归我为圣。他们都要属于我。我是{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}。”
zh.R: 所有头生的都属于我。我杀死埃及所有头生的时候，就把以色列所有头生的，包括人和牲畜，都分别出来归我。他们是属于我的。我是{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}。”

tl.L: Sapagkat ang bawat panganay [ay] akin. Sa araw na pinatay ko ang bawat panganay sa lupain ng Egipto, ibinukod ko para sa akin ang bawat panganay sa Israel, mula sa tao hanggang sa hayop. Sila ay magiging akin. Ako [si] {{divine_name:ang PANGINOON|si Yahweh}}."
tl.B: Sapagkat ang bawat panganay ay akin. Nang patayin ko ang bawat panganay sa lupain ng Egipto, itinalaga kong banal para sa akin ang bawat panganay sa Israel, tao man o hayop. Sila ay magiging akin. Ako {{divine_name:ang PANGINOON|si Yahweh}}."
tl.R: Ang bawat panganay ay akin. Nang patayin ko ang lahat ng panganay sa Egipto, ibinukod ko para sa akin ang bawat panganay sa Israel, tao man o hayop. Sila ay akin. Ako {{divine_name:ang PANGINOON|si Yahweh}}."

decisions.choice: the day I struck every firstborn in Egypt: the last plague
decisions.reason: God struck the firstborn of Egypt and passed over Israel's houses (Exodus 12:12, 29). From then on Israel's firstborn, of people and of animals, belonged to him (Exodus 13:2, 11-15).

decisions.choice: I set apart: made holy, claimed as belonging to God
decisions.reason: The verb means to make something holy, set apart for God's own use. The firstborn were his; that is why they had to be given to him or bought back (Exodus 13:13; 34:20).

decisions.choice: from man to beast: people and animals alike
decisions.reason: A way of saying "all", from one end of the range to the other. The Levites replace the firstborn sons; firstborn animals of the Levites replace those of Israel's livestock (verses 41, 45).

decisions.choice: I am Yahweh: the seal on the command
decisions.reason: The closing words give God's own name as the authority for what he has said, as often in Leviticus (Leviticus 18:5; 19:12).

decisions.choice: made holy to myself
decisions.reason: Balanced uses "made holy" to keep the link with "holy" (m2); Literal and Readable use "set apart".

decisions.choice: "người" for "man" in "from man to beast", with no gender span
decisions.reason: "người" means a human being of either sex, so Vietnamese has one wording for both of the English setting's choices.

decisions.choice: "처음 난 것" where the firstborn of people and animals are meant together; "맏아들" for the firstborn sons of Israel (3:12, 40-50)
decisions.reason: The term sheet sets "맏아들" for a firstborn son and "처음 난 것" for the firstborn of animals; a verse that joins people and beasts needs the wider word. "사람" covers the English "human / man" setting, so Korean needs no gender span.

decisions.choice: consagrei (B); separei (L, R)
decisions.reason: Balanced says "consagrei", which keeps the link with holiness (m2) as the English "made holy" does, and reads more naturally than "santifiquei"; Literal and Readable say "separei", as the English "set apart".

decisions.choice: "ከሰው እስከ እንስሳ" with no gender span.
decisions.reason: "ሰው" already means a human being of either sex, so the English span ("human" or "man") has nothing to switch in Amharic.

decisions.choice: "मनुष्य" with no gender span
decisions.reason: The English offers "human" and "man". Hindi "मनुष्य" already means a human being of either sex, so there is nothing for the setting to change.

decisions.choice: hiqdish "聖別した" (L, B), "取り分けた" (R)
decisions.reason: As settled for Exodus (聖別する at L and B); Readable says set apart for me.

decisions.choice: "人から家畜に至るまで" with no gender span
decisions.reason: 人 already means a human being, so the English span human/man needs none in Japanese.

decisions.choice: a deity pronoun span on "собі" / "себе" here, where the English has one on "myself"
decisions.reason: The reflexive normally takes no span, but here it stands for the English "myself" with its own span, and the capital marks that God claims the firstborn for himself; the span keeps the two languages alike.

decisions.choice: 归我为圣
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps the link with "holy" (m2), as the English "made holy"; Literal and Readable say "分别出来" (set apart).

decisions.choice: 人 (no gender span)
decisions.reason: The English Literal has a gender span on "human / man". Chinese "人" already means any person, so no span is needed.

decisions.choice: "Sa araw na pinatay ko ang bawat panganay" (L); "Nang patayin ko" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The last plague (m1).

decisions.choice: "ibinukod ko" (L, R); "itinalaga kong banal" (B)
decisions.reason: Made holy, claimed as belonging to God (m2), as English (en1).

decisions.choice: "mula sa tao hanggang sa hayop" (L); "tao man o hayop" (B, R)
decisions.reason: People and animals alike (m3).

decisions.choice: "Ako [si] ang PANGINOON" (L)
decisions.reason: The seal on the command (m4).

uk.L: І {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} говорив до Мойсея в пустелі Синай, кажучи:
uk.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} говорив до Мойсея в пустелі Синай. Він сказав:
uk.R: У Синайській пустелі {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} сказав Мойсеєві:

id.L: Dan {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}} berfirman kepada Musa di padang gurun Sinai, firman-{{deity_pronoun:nya|Nya}},
id.B: Di padang gurun Sinai {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}} berfirman kepada Musa:
id.R: Di padang gurun Sinai {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}} berfirman kepada Musa,

zh.L: {{divine_name:上主|雅威}}在西奈的旷野对摩西说话，说：
zh.B: {{divine_name:上主|雅威}}在西奈旷野对摩西说：
zh.R: 在西奈荒野，{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}对摩西说：

tl.L: At nagsalita {{divine_name:ang PANGINOON|si Yahweh}} kay Moises sa ilang ng Sinai, na sinasabi,
tl.B: Nagsalita {{divine_name:ang PANGINOON|si Yahweh}} kay Moises sa ilang ng Sinai. Sinabi {{deity_pronoun:niya|Niya}},
tl.R: Sa disyerto ng Sinai, sinabi {{divine_name:ng PANGINOON|ni Yahweh}} kay Moises,

decisions.choice: the wilderness of Sinai: the dry country around the mountain
decisions.reason: Israel was still camped near Mount Sinai (1:1). "Wilderness" is open, dry grazing land, not necessarily sand desert.

decisions.choice: desert
decisions.reason: Readable uses the more familiar word "desert" for the wilderness, as in verse 4.

decisions.choice: "ilang" (L, B); "disyerto" (R)
decisions.reason: The dry country around the mountain (m1), as English (en1).

source.text: פְּקֹד֙ אֶת־בְּנֵ֣י לֵוִ֔י לְבֵ֥ית אֲבֹתָ֖ם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑ם כָּל־זָכָ֛ר מִבֶּן־חֹ֥דֶשׁ וָמַ֖עְלָה תִּפְקְדֵֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Enroll [the] sons of Levi by [the] house of their fathers, by their clans; every male from a son of a month and upward you will enroll them.

en.L: "Enroll the sons of Levi by the house of their fathers, by their clans; every male from a son of a month and upward you shall enroll them."
en.B: "Enroll the Levites by their ancestral families and their clans. Enroll every male one month old and up."
en.R: "Count the Levites by their families and clans. Count every boy and man who is at least one month old."

es.L: «Alista a los hijos de Leví por la casa de sus padres, por sus clanes; a todo varón desde [la edad de] un mes en adelante los alistarás».
es.B: «Alista a los levitas por familias y por clanes. Alista a todo varón de un mes o más».
es.R: «Cuenta a los levitas por familias y clanes. Cuenta a todos los niños y hombres que tengan por lo menos un mes».

fr.L: « Recense les fils de Lévi selon la maison de leurs pères, selon leurs clans ; tout mâle depuis [l’âge d’]un mois et au-dessus, tu les recenseras. »
fr.B: « Recense les Lévites par familles et par clans. Tu recenseras tous les garçons et les hommes âgés d’un mois et plus. »
fr.R: « Compte les Lévites par familles et par clans. Compte tous les garçons et les hommes qui ont au moins un mois. »

sw.L: "Uwaandikishe wana wa Lawi kwa nyumba ya baba zao, kwa koo zao; kila wa kiume kuanzia mwana wa mwezi mmoja na zaidi utawaandikisha."
sw.B: "Uwaandikishe Walawi kwa jamaa na kwa koo zao. Umwandikishe kila wa kiume mwenye umri wa mwezi mmoja na zaidi."
sw.R: "Wahesabu Walawi kwa jamaa na koo zao. Mhesabu kila mvulana na mwanamume aliye na angalau mwezi mmoja."

vi.L: "Hãy kiểm kê con cháu Lê-vi theo nhà cha họ, theo gia tộc của họ; mọi người nam từ một tháng tuổi trở lên, ngươi sẽ kiểm kê họ."
vi.B: "Hãy kiểm kê người Lê-vi theo gia đình và gia tộc. Hãy kiểm kê mọi người nam từ một tháng tuổi trở lên."
vi.R: "Hãy đếm người Lê-vi theo gia đình và gia tộc. Hãy đếm mọi bé trai và đàn ông từ một tháng tuổi trở lên."

ko.L: "레위 자손을 그들의 조상의 집대로, 그들의 가문대로 계수하여라. 한 달 된 아들부터 그 이상으로 모든 남자를 너는 계수하여라."
ko.B: "레위인을 집안과 가문별로 계수하여라. 태어난 지 한 달 이상 된 남자를 모두 계수하여라."
ko.R: "레위인을 집안과 가문별로 세어라. 태어난 지 한 달 이상 된 남자아이와 남자를 모두 세어야 한다."

pt.L: "Recenseia os filhos de Levi segundo as suas famílias, segundo os seus clãs; todos os do sexo masculino de um mês para cima, tu os recensearás."
pt.B: "Recenseia os levitas segundo as suas famílias e os seus clãs. Recenseia todos os do sexo masculino de um mês para cima."
pt.R: "Conta os levitas por famílias e clãs. Conta todos os meninos e homens de pelo menos um mês de idade."

am.L: «የሌዊን ልጆች በየአባቶቻቸው ቤት፣ በየጎሳቸው ቁጠር፤ ከአንድ ወር ልጅ ጀምሮ ከዚያም በላይ ያለውን ወንድ ሁሉ ትቆጥራቸዋለህ።»
am.B: «ሌዋውያንን በየቤተሰባቸውና በየጎሳቸው መዝግብ። ዕድሜው አንድ ወርና ከዚያ በላይ የሆነውን ወንድ ሁሉ መዝግብ።»
am.R: «ሌዋውያንን በየቤተሰባቸውና በየጎሳቸው ቁጠር። ዕድሜው ቢያንስ አንድ ወር የሆነውን ወንድ ሁሉ፣ ሕፃንም ይሁን አዋቂ፣ ቁጠር።»

hi.L: "लेवी के पुत्रों को उनके पितृकुल के अनुसार, उनके कुलों के अनुसार गिनो; एक महीने के पुत्र से और ऊपर के हर पुरुष को तुम गिनना।"
hi.B: "लेवियों को उनके परिवारों और कुलों के अनुसार गिनो। एक महीने या उससे अधिक आयु के हर पुरुष को गिनो।"
hi.R: "लेवियों को उनके परिवारों और कुलों के अनुसार गिनो। हर लड़के और पुरुष को गिनो जो कम से कम एक महीने का हो।"

ru.L: «Исчисли сыновей Левия по их отцовскому дому, по их родам; всякого мужского пола от месяца и выше исчисли их.»
ru.B: «Исчисли левитов по их семьям и родам. Исчисли всех мужского пола в возрасте от одного месяца и старше.»
ru.R: «Посчитай левитов по семьям и родам. Посчитай всех мальчиков и мужчин, которым исполнился хотя бы один месяц.»

ja.L: 「レビの子らを、その父祖の家ごと、その氏族ごとに登録しなさい。一か月[の者]から上のすべての男子を、あなたは登録しなければならない。」
ja.B: 「レビ人を、父祖の家ごと、氏族ごとに登録しなさい。生後一か月以上の男子を皆、登録しなさい。」
ja.R: 「レビ人を、家族ごと、一族ごとに数えなさい。生まれて一か月以上の男の子と男を、みな数えなさい。」

uk.L: «Перепиши синів Левія за домом їхніх батьків, за їхніми родами; кожного чоловічої статі від сина одного місяця і вище перепишеш їх.»
uk.B: «Перепиши левитів за їхніми родинами й родами. Перепиши кожного хлопчика й чоловіка від одного місяця і старше.»
uk.R: «Порахуй левитів за родинами й родами. Порахуй кожного хлопчика й чоловіка, якому щонайменше місяць.»

id.L: "Daftarlah bani Lewi menurut keluarga bapa mereka, menurut kaum-kaum mereka; setiap laki-laki yang berumur satu bulan ke atas haruslah engkau daftar."
id.B: "Daftarkanlah orang Lewi menurut keluarga dan kaum mereka. Daftarkanlah setiap laki-laki yang berumur satu bulan ke atas."
id.R: "Hitunglah orang Lewi menurut keluarga dan kaumnya. Hitunglah setiap anak laki-laki dan laki-laki dewasa yang berumur paling sedikit satu bulan."

zh.L: “你要按着利未子孙的父家，按着他们的宗族数点他们；凡一个月以上的男子，你都要数点。”
zh.B: “你要按着家族和宗族登记利未人。凡一个月以上的男子，都要登记。”
zh.R: “你要按着家族和宗族数点利未人。每一个满一个月的男孩和男人，都要数点。”

tl.L: "Itala mo ang mga anak ni Levi ayon sa sambahayan ng kanilang mga ama, ayon sa kanilang mga angkan; ang bawat lalaki mula sa isang buwang gulang pataas ay itatala mo."
tl.B: "Itala mo ang mga Levita ayon sa sambahayan ng kanilang mga ninuno at ayon sa kanilang mga angkan. Itala mo ang bawat lalaking isang buwang gulang pataas."
tl.R: "Bilangin mo ang mga Levita ayon sa kanilang pamilya at angkan. Bilangin mo ang bawat batang lalaki at lalaking may isang buwang gulang man lamang."

decisions.choice: enroll: count and record by name
decisions.reason: The verb means to visit, inspect or muster, and in the census lists to count and register people (1:2-3, 19). The same verb means "appoint" in verse 10.

decisions.choice: every male from one month old: a count for the sanctuary, not for war
decisions.reason: The other tribes were counted from twenty years old as men able to go to war (1:3). The Levites are counted from one month, the age at which a firstborn son was bought back (18:15-16), because they are to stand in place of Israel's firstborn (verses 40-43).

decisions.choice: house of their fathers, clans: the family groups within a tribe
decisions.reason: A tribe was made up of clans, and a clan of ancestral households, each named for a forefather (1:2).

decisions.choice: enroll / count
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced use "enroll", as in the census of chapter 1, and Readable "count", each time the verb is used for the census in this chapter.

decisions.choice: "tous les garçons et les hommes"
decisions.reason: Chapter 1 says "tout homme" at Balanced and Readable for men of twenty and over; here the count starts at one month (m2), so "homme" alone would leave out the baby boys. Literal keeps "tout mâle", as in chapter 1.

decisions.choice: "kila wa kiume" (L, B); "kila mvulana na mwanamume" (R)
decisions.reason: Chapter 1 says "kila mwanamume" for men of twenty and over; here the count starts at one month (m2), and "mwanamume" would suggest grown men only. "Wa kiume" covers every male, baby or man; Readable spells it out.

decisions.choice: "mọi bé trai và đàn ông" for "every male" at Readable
decisions.reason: The count starts at one month old; Readable names both babies and men so that the reader sees this is not the count of fighting men in chapter 1, as the English Readable does with "every boy and man".

decisions.choice: todos os do sexo masculino (L, B); todos os meninos e homens (R)
decisions.reason: For the Levite counts of chapters 3 and the firstborn: those counted include babies of one month (m2), so "todo homem", used in 1:2 for men of war, would be wrong here. "Do sexo masculino" is the plain Portuguese for "male" of people ("macho" is said of animals); Readable says "meninos e homens", as the English Readable says "boy and man". The verb is "recensear" (L, B) and "contar" (R), as set at 1:2.

decisions.choice: from a son of a month "生後一か月以上" (B), "生まれて一か月以上の男の子と男" (R)
decisions.reason: A count for the sanctuary, not for war (meaning decision m2), so it includes infants; Readable says boys and men, as the English does.

decisions.choice: 数点 (L, R), 登记 (B)
decisions.reason: The census verb keeps the forms of chapter 1 at each level. "Every male" from one month old is "男孩和男人" at Readable, as the English "boy and man" (m2).

decisions.choice: "Itala" (L, B); "Bilangin" (R)
decisions.reason: Count and record by name (m1), as English (en1).

decisions.choice: "mula sa isang buwang gulang pataas" (L)
decisions.reason: A count for the sanctuary, not for war (m2).

decisions.choice: "sambahayan ng kanilang mga ama ... angkan" (L)
decisions.reason: The family groups within a tribe (m3).

source.text: וַיִּפְקֹ֥ד אֹתָ֛ם מֹשֶׁ֖ה עַל־פִּ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר צֻוָּֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And enrolled them Moses according to [the] mouth of Yahweh, as he had been commanded.

en.L: And Moses enrolled them at the mouth of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, as he had been commanded.
en.B: So Moses enrolled them at the command of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, as he had been commanded.
en.R: So Moses counted them, just as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had told him to do.

es.L: Y los alistó Moisés conforme a la boca {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, como le había sido mandado.
es.B: Así que Moisés los alistó por orden {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, como se le había mandado.
es.R: Así que Moisés los contó, tal como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le había dicho.

fr.L: Et Moïse les recensa selon la bouche {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, comme il en avait reçu l’ordre.
fr.B: Moïse les recensa donc sur l’ordre {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, comme cela lui avait été ordonné.
fr.R: Moïse les a donc comptés, exactement comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} le lui avait dit.

sw.L: Na Musa akawaandikisha kwa kinywa cha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kama alivyoamriwa.
sw.B: Basi Musa aliwaandikisha kwa agizo la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kama alivyokuwa ameamriwa.
sw.R: Basi Musa aliwahesabu, sawasawa na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyomwambia afanye.

vi.L: Và Môi-se kiểm kê họ theo miệng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, như ông đã được truyền.
vi.B: Vậy Môi-se kiểm kê họ theo lệnh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, đúng như ông đã được truyền.
vi.R: Vậy Môi-se đếm họ, đúng như {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã bảo ông.

ko.L: 그리고 모세는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 입을 따라, 자기가 명령받은 대로 그들을 계수하였다.
ko.B: 그래서 모세는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 명령에 따라, 자기가 명령받은 대로 그들을 계수했다.
ko.R: 그래서 모세는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 말씀하신 대로 그들을 세었다.

pt.L: E Moisés os recenseou pela boca {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, como lhe tinha sido ordenado.
pt.B: Assim Moisés os recenseou por ordem {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, como lhe tinha sido ordenado.
pt.R: Assim Moisés contou os levitas, exatamente como {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} tinha mandado.

am.L: ሙሴም እንደ ታዘዘው {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ቃል ቆጠራቸው።
am.B: ስለዚህ ሙሴ እንደ ታዘዘው {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ትእዛዝ መዘገባቸው።
am.R: ስለዚህ ሙሴ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲያደርግ እንደ ነገረው ቆጠራቸው።

hi.L: और मूसा ने {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के मुँह के अनुसार उन्हें गिना, जैसी उसे आज्ञा दी गई थी।
hi.B: इस तरह मूसा ने {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की आज्ञा से उन्हें गिना, जैसी उसे आज्ञा दी गई थी।
hi.R: तब मूसा ने उन्हें गिना, ठीक जैसा {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने उससे कहा था।

ru.L: И исчислил их Моисей по устам {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, как ему было повелено.
ru.B: Так Моисей исчислил их по повелению {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, как ему было повелено.
ru.R: Моисей посчитал их, как ему велел {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}.

ja.L: そしてモーセは、命じられたとおりに、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の口に従って彼らを登録した。
ja.B: そこでモーセは、命じられたとおりに、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の命令に従って彼らを登録した。
ja.R: そこでモーセは、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が言われたとおりに、彼らを数えました。

uk.L: І Мойсей переписав їх за устами {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, як йому було наказано.
uk.B: Тож Мойсей переписав їх за наказом {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, як йому було наказано.
uk.R: Тож Мойсей порахував їх так, як йому сказав {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}.

id.L: Dan Musa mendaftar mereka menurut titah {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}, sebagaimana dia diperintahkan.
id.B: Lalu Musa mendaftarkan mereka sesuai dengan firman {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}, seperti yang diperintahkan kepadanya.
id.R: Musa pun menghitung mereka, tepat seperti yang dikatakan {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}} kepadanya.

zh.L: 摩西就照着{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}口中的话数点他们，正如他所受的吩咐。
zh.B: 于是摩西遵照{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}的命令登记了他们，正如他所受的吩咐。
zh.R: 于是摩西照着{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}吩咐他的，数点了他们。

tl.L: At itinala sila ni Moises ayon sa bibig {{divine_name:ng PANGINOON|ni Yahweh}}, gaya ng iniutos sa kaniya.
tl.B: Kaya itinala sila ni Moises ayon sa utos {{divine_name:ng PANGINOON|ni Yahweh}}, gaya ng iniutos sa kaniya.
tl.R: Kaya binilang sila ni Moises, gaya ng sinabi {{divine_name:ng PANGINOON|ni Yahweh}} na gawin niya.

decisions.choice: according to the mouth of Yahweh: at the LORD's command
decisions.reason: "Mouth" stands for what someone says. Moses acts on the LORD's spoken word (verses 39, 51; 9:18).

decisions.choice: just as the LORD had told him
decisions.reason: Readable names the one who commanded, whom the Hebrew passive leaves unnamed but plain from the context.

decisions.choice: "theo miệng" (L), "theo lệnh" (B) for "according to the mouth of"
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew picture, which a Vietnamese reader can follow; Balanced gives its sense, the LORD's command. Used again in 3:39, 51 and 4:37-49.

decisions.choice: pela boca do SENHOR (L); por ordem do SENHOR (B)
decisions.reason: For the whole book: Literal keeps the idiom "mouth" for what the LORD says (m1), as Exodus 38:21 says "pela boca de Moisés"; Balanced says "por ordem". Readable names the one who commanded, as the English does, with "mandado" to avoid repeating "ordenado".

decisions.choice: "በ… ቃል" (L) and "በ… ትእዛዝ" (B) for "according to the mouth of" YHWH, through the book.
decisions.reason: Amharic does not say a command comes from someone's "mouth"; "ቃል" (word) is the nearest natural form and keeps Literal close to the Hebrew picture.

decisions.choice: according to the mouth of YHWH "主の口に従って" (L), "命令に従って" (B), "言われたとおりに" (R)
decisions.reason: The idiom means at the LORD's command (meaning decision m1); Literal keeps mouth.

decisions.choice: "menurut titah {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}" (L) for "at the mouth of the LORD"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "at the mouth" means at the command (m1); "titah", a command from above, keeps the sense of the spoken order at Literal, and Balanced says "firman". For the whole of Numbers.

decisions.choice: 照着上主口中的话
decisions.reason: "According to the mouth of the LORD" means at his command (m1). Literal keeps the mouth as "口中的话", since "照着……的口" is not Chinese; Balanced and Readable say "命令" / "吩咐".

decisions.choice: "ayon sa bibig" (L); "ayon sa utos" (B); "gaya ng sinabi" (R)
decisions.reason: At the LORD's command (m1), as English (en1).

decisions.choice: Gershon, Kohath and Merari: the sons of Levi
decisions.reason: The same three are listed in Genesis 46:11 and Exodus 6:16. Each gives his name to one of the three Levite groups whose work and camp are set out in verses 21-37.

decisions.choice: "게르손", "그핫", "므라리", and in 3:18-35 "립니", "시므이", "아므람", "이스할", "헤브론", "웃시엘", "마흘리", "무시", "엘리사반", "라엘", "수리엘", "아비하일"
decisions.reason: The forms Korean Exodus 6:16-22 already uses for Levi's family; "그핫" rather than "고핫", which some Korean Chronicles passages have, so that the Pentateuch reads as one.

decisions.choice: Levi's sons and grandsons as in Exodus 6:16-22: ጌድሶን, ቀዓት, ሜራሪ; ሎቤኒ, ሰሜኢ; እንበረም, ይስዓር, ኬብሮን, ዑዝኤል; ሞሖሊ, ሙሲ. The clans are named with "-ውያን": ጌድሶናውያን, ቀዓታውያን, ሜራራውያን, ሎቤናውያን, ሰሜአውያን, እንበረማውያን, ይስዓራውያን, ኬብሮናውያን, ዑዝኤላውያን, ሞሖላውያን, ሙሳውያን.
alternatives: "የጌድሶን ልጆች" for "the Gershonites" at every level
decisions.reason: One spelling for the whole Pentateuch. The "-ውያን" forms answer the Hebrew clan names ("the Libnite", "the Gershonite"), as "ቆሬያውያን" does in Exodus 6:24.

decisions.choice: "Гершон", "Кегат", "Мерарі"; the clans as "рід X" and the groups as "гершонівці", "кегатівці", "мерарівці"
decisions.reason: The sons of Levi are transcribed from the Hebrew, with г for h. For the clans named after a son (the Libnites, the Amramites) Ukrainian says "рід Лівні", "рід Амрама", which is clear where a coined adjective would not be; the three larger groups take the forms in -івці.

decisions.choice: "Gerson", "Kehat", "Merari" for the sons of Levi
decisions.reason: Established forms; Kohath's "o" is written "e" as Indonesian church usage has it ("Kehat"). Added to the glossary.

decisions.choice: 革顺, 哥辖, 米拉利
decisions.reason: The sons of Levi and their sons (verses 17-20) keep the forms of Exodus 6:16-19: 立尼, 示每; 暗兰, 以斯哈, 希伯仑, 乌薛; 抹利, 母示.

am.L: የጌድሶንም ልጆች ስሞች በየጎሳቸው እነዚህ [ናቸው]፤ ሎቤኒና ሰሜኢ።
